comment: Verification anchors for the Prayag Sales Intelligence dashboard. All money in rupees. Primary source of truth: the client's approved, signed-off files. Tolerances: moneyPassPct/countPassPct are percent of expected (pass within, warn within 2x, fail beyond); memberCountAbs is absolute; coverageMinPct is the minimum share of the company net total the roster spine must attribute to a member.

2025-26.comment: Source: STATE HEAD DASHBOARD FY2025-26 (live Google Sheet, authoritative). Secondary order booking basis (Sub Total) = Rs 231.09 Cr. Retired transaction-file basis was Rs 240.14 Cr — that figure is superseded and must not be used as the anchor.

primary_anchors.comment: Source: State Head Sale registers, independently recomputed. Basis: Taxable Value (net dispatch). CANARY — Biju C.O: if BIJJU/BIJU CO in the register does not map to 'Biju C.O' via the head-name alias map, the per-head check shows Rs 0 and normalisation is broken. The 'perHeadOrderBooking' figures are ORDER BOOKING (from the order-book file), NOT dispatch. The dispatch total is the 'total' field.

2026-27.closedMonthsNote: Closed months Apr-Jun 2026 (months 1-3 of FY2026-27). July is still open and excluded. Updated 2026-07-20 after reconcile-versions: 54 rows in May-26 and Jun-26 were genuine rate corrections (Rs 4.6 L combined). Apr=5542 rows Rs 13.11 Cr; May=11925 rows Rs 28.38 Cr; Jun=12997 rows Rs 31.56 Cr; total Rs 73.04 Cr. Update closedMonths + closedMonthsTotal in verify_anchors.json when July closes.

target_anchors.comment: RETIRED — Target Master sheet (1ZLok3...) is retired. Secondary targets, CTC, designations, and stateHead assignments all come live from the STATE HEAD DASHBOARD Google Sheet. All Group A and Group E checks derived from these anchors are disabled.
